title: Signed at 13, Now $165 Million: Luka Dončić
description:
Luka Dončić signed with Real Madrid at 13, and now has a Lakers extension worth up to 165 million dollars.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Luka Dončić: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luka_Don%C4%8Di%C4%87
- NBC Sports: Luka Doncic signs three-year, $165 million extension to remain with Lakers: https://www.nbcsports.com/nba/news/luka-doncic-signs-three-year-165-million-extension-to-remain-with-lakers

From the cited pages: in September 2012, at 13, Dončić signed a five-year contract with Real Madrid; on April 30, 2015, at 16, he made his pro debut and became the youngest player to ever play for Real Madrid in the ACB; he won the EuroLeague MVP in 2018; he was drafted third overall by the Atlanta Hawks in 2018 and traded to the Dallas Mavericks; on February 2, 2025, he was traded to the Los Angeles Lakers; on August 2, 2025, he signed a three-year max extension (two guaranteed years plus a player option) that can be worth up to 165 million dollars. Not financial advice.

#shorts #lukadoncic #nba #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time someone says you're too young, remember:
first_comment: Would you sign a pro deal at 13? Be honest 👇

scenes.narration: Luka Dončić signed with Real Madrid at only 13. So how did he land a Lakers deal worth up to 165 million dollars?
Then at 16, he plays his first pro game. In 2018, he wins the EuroLeague MVP.
Yet Dallas trades him to the Lakers in 2025. It shocks the whole league.
Six months later, he signs a three-year extension.
Not bad for a kid who signed at 13.
